description: 5 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars cover the When-to-use list and the description's 'fires even on this is broken / quick fix' clause: an unexplained test failure, a flaky test, staging behaving unexpectedly, a fix that did not hold, and a terse German 'it's broken, quick fix'. Near-misses are the two neighbours this skill's Do-NOT list routes to by name (data-flow-mapper, blast-radius-analyzer) plus the retrospective root-cause analysis of an already-resolved incident (root-cause-frameworks). Counterexamples are the two exclusions the skill states outright: a failure message that already names the fix, and pure lint/formatting.

queries.q: the OrderTotalTest fails on CI but passes locally and I don't see why
this integration test is flaky — it fails roughly one run in five
staging shows the wrong currency on invoices since Tuesday — find the root cause before anyone changes code
the fix we shipped last week didn't resolve the duplicate emails, and now some aren't sent at all
der Import ist kaputt, mach mal schnell einen Fix
trace where the customer email field flows from the signup form to the CRM export
queries.note: a static trace of one data element, no failure to reproduce → data-flow-mapper, named in this skill's Do-NOT list

queries.q: before I rename this service method, list everything that calls it
queries.note: enumerating what a planned change touches → blast-radius-analyzer, named in this skill's Do-NOT list

queries.q: the outage is resolved — run a 5-whys on why the cache keeps falling over
queries.note: root-cause vocabulary, but retrospective analysis of a resolved incident rather than live reproduce-isolate-verify → root-cause-frameworks

queries.q: ImportError: cannot import name 'Invoice' — I renamed it to Invoices, update the import
queries.note: the failure message already names the fix, which the skill's Do-NOT list excludes

queries.q: fix the trailing-whitespace lint warnings in the config folder
queries.note: pure lint/formatting, excluded by the skill's Do-NOT list
